resources.string: Comma-separated, for example xhdpi,xxhdpi. Empty keeps all densities.
Comma-separated qualifiers, for example en,fr. Empty keeps all configurations.
Comma-separated ABIs to retain, for example arm64-v8a. Empty keeps all.
Leave empty to preserve the APK value.

A new APK will be created. Removing resources or libraries and changing SDK levels can break compatibility. The original signature is invalidated; sign the result with a compatible key before installing. Stored native libraries are aligned to 4 KB, which may not work on devices requiring 16 KB alignment.
